description:
DependentHook is the compiled form of a KindDefinition.dependents
 entry: each hook source is bundled, and the params JSON Schema is
 embedded inline so rendering does not need access to the original
 kind directory.

^(paramsSchema)$.description: Inlined contents of the params JSON Schema (raw JSON text).

hooks.description: Compiled, bundled dependent hooks in declaration order.

items.description:
Hook is a single hook bundled and minified from its TS/JS source,
 with all of its imports resolved and inlined. Used for both render-
 lifecycle entries (Hooks.render) and dependent-lifecycle entries
 (DependentHook.hooks); the shape is the same in either context.

access.description:
Host resources this hook is permitted to reach (carried forward
 from the kind.json hook entry). The render runner pre-flights each
 declared resource and exposes only what's listed to the hook.

env.description:
Environment variables the hook intends to read. Each entry must
 describe both the name and why it's needed; the description is
 surfaced in pre-flight error messages when the var is missing.

items.description: EnvAccess names a single host environment variable a hook needs.

description.description:
A brief description of what this key is used for and why. Surfaced
 when the var is missing so the user can correct the issue.

name.description:
The env var being requested by the hook. Must match the conventions
 for valid POSIX environment-variable identifiers.

items.title: Env Access

access.title: Hook Access

content.description: Minified JavaScript bundle, ES module format.

name.description: Relative path from the kind directory (e.g. "hooks/hello-world.ts").

items.title: Hook

kind.description:
The consumer kind that may depend on this resource (matches
 DependentDefinition.kind).

params_schema.description: Inlined contents of the params JSON Schema (raw JSON text).

sources.description: Embedded templates instantiated once per resolved target per root.

items.description:
Source is one compiled source file: where it lives in the kind, what
 it contains, and the schema it is checked against. Everything a
 consumer needs to read and validate the file is inlined here, so
 render never reaches back to the kind directory.

contents.description: Raw file contents. May be empty: an empty source file is valid.

path.description:
Path relative to the kind directory (e.g. "sources/app.json"). Also
 the source's identity through the render pipeline — hooks may remap
 where a file is written without changing this.

schema.description:
Inlined JSON Schema for this source, as raw JSON text — like
 DependentHook.params_schema, so validation needs no filesystem
 access to the kind directory. Unset when the source declared no
 schema, in which case its contents are never schema-checked.
